Marceline Tran: Hey team! I'm starting today — Marceline from Product Design. Quick q: who should I ping for MDM laptop and VPN access? Also putting in a sticker request: ramen + cactus :ramen::cactus:
Sam Wells: hey! i'm your onboarding buddy — congrats :tada:. Ping @Hannah (IT). I'll set up a 1pm sync and DM the checklist. What's your laptop preference? MacBook Air or Pro?
Marceline Tran: Thanks Sam! MacBook Pro (16") would be awesome if available. Also could someone drop the VPN setup link here?
Hannah (IT): Hi Marceline — welcome! Sending MDM invite now. You should get an email from 'mdm-bot' in ~5 minutes. VPN guide is at https://intra.redwood/vpn-setup. For SSH, once keys are provisioned run:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa marceline@jump.redwood
```
If the key isn't there, reply and I'll create one for you.
mdm-bot: MDM enrollment email sent to marceline.tran@redwood.ai — follow the link to enroll your device. If you hit an error, react with :bug: and support will follow up.
Marceline Tran: Got the email and starting enrollment now. Quick Q — where's the sticker preference form?
Brynn Ortiz: Welcome Marceline! Sticker form is pinned in #people-ops (https://intra.redwood/people-stickers). Also lunchtime welcome at 12:30 in the kitchen if you're on-site — meet the product crew :sandwich:
Sam Wells: Dropping your access checklist in DM in a sec. Happy first day! :party_parrot:
Marceline Tran: Thanks everyone — enrolling + will grab lunch. Appreciate the speedy help, excited to be here!
